privacy.title: Before you continue
privacy.p1: Your lawyer's firm keeps your case file in Kleidi. You can see the progress of your purchase, the documents your lawyer shares with you, and send documents securely.
privacy.p2: Your details are stored in the European Union and used only for your case. Every document you send is checked for viruses, and your lawyer sees who sent what and when.
privacy.p3: You can ask your lawyer for a copy of your data, or for it to be deleted when the law allows.
